summary:
Implementation plan for Finora's complete PDF & Invoice Generation System.
Includes:
- Architecture & Database schema with Room entities (invoices, invoice_items, pdf_reports), DAO, Repository, and Migration 7->8.
- Native Android PdfDocument rendering engine with custom text layout and bundled Noto Sans Bengali font support.
- 5 comprehensive PDF modules: Invoice Generator, Income & Expense Report, Savings & Investment Report, Due & Ledger Statement, and Generated Reports History.
- Native Android sharing, printing, SAF export, and preview integration.
- Navigation integration into FinoraApp, FinoraDrawer, and HisabPatiHubScreen without regressions.
- Unit and Robolectric verification tests.
